summary: Frontend-only validation of the Multitienda modal balance gate on /quotes 'Enviar a Implementación'. Logged in as admin, navigated to COT-2026-06-039-PYME (52 cajas, status=Enviada → irregular path). Successfully passed exception-modal (motivo+fecha) + email comunicación modal and reached multistore-dialog → ask phase → collect phase. Verified (a) layout cap (dialog h=355px ≤ 864px=80vh), (b) collect-stores-scroll scrollable area exists, (c) multistore-confirm-btn visible in fixed footer, (d) counter renders exact text 'Cajas Distribuidas: 0 / Cantidad Inicial Obligatoria: 52' with data-balanced='false' + RED classes (bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-300). Hard-block toast & green transition logic verified via thorough code review of Quotes.jsx confirmMultistore/confirmInheritedStores (exact Spanish toast message present, hard-blocks before any state advance) and QuoteModals.jsx (counter colour/data-balanced toggles correctly; footer is shrink-0 with list flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto). Backend balance 400 already verified by main agent via curl.
critical_code_review_comments: QuoteModals.jsx line 625: conditional max-h-[80vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden is correctly applied only to inherited/collect phases — early phases (ask/project_type/equipment/pinpad) keep their original sizing. Good.

Counter and footer reuse the same classes/data-testid pattern across both phases — DRY is acceptable; minor duplication of the balance-counter <div> block could be extracted into a shared <BalanceCounter scope='collect|inherited'/> component if file grows.
Quotes.jsx is 4337 lines — exceeds 700 LOC guideline. Consider splitting multistore wizard state/handlers into a dedicated hook (useMultistoreWizard) for maintainability.

Confirm button stays enabled when balance != initial (intentional, so the toast can fire on click). Acceptable UX, but consider adding aria-describedby pointing to the balance counter for screen readers.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (verified parts) — 4/6 of the explicit checks were exercised via Playwright; the remaining 2 (toast text on click + green state on rebalance) were validated via code review of the exact handler paths since the add-store input selector timed out in automation

context_for_next_testing_agent: To reach the multistore dialog on this quote (status=Enviada, not Pagada): (1) login UI; (2) open kebab data-testid='quote-actions-quo_07dc95aace99'; (3) click menuitem 'Enviar a Implementación' (no testid, find by text); (4) exception-modal opens — fill textarea + date input[type='date'] + click data-testid='exception-confirm-btn'; (5) email 'Personalizar Comunicación' modal opens — click 'Continuar'; (6) multistore-dialog opens at ask-phase; (7) click multistore-yes-btn → collect-phase. The MultistoreAddForm input lives at '[data-testid=multistore-collect-phase] input[placeholder*="Tienda"]' — use that placeholder selector instead of input[type='text'] which timed out for me. Add stores via Agregar btn, click multistore-confirm-btn at deficit to see toast 'No se puede continuar: ...', then add more to balance exactly to 52 and click again to advance to pinpad-question-phase.
